import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Naive BST insertion, without any precondition attached. -/
def ins (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty =>
    BinarySearchTree.Node v BinarySearchTree.Empty BinarySearchTree.Empty
  | BinarySearchTree.Node w l r =>
    if v < w then BinarySearchTree.Node w (ins l v) r
    else if w < v then BinarySearchTree.Node w l (ins r v)
    else BinarySearchTree.Node w l r
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t v) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ins t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : insert_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∪ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem view_ins (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) :
    view (ins t v) = view t ∪ {v} := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => simp [ins, view]
  | Node w l r ihl ihr =>
    rcases lt_trichotomy v w with hc | hc | hc
    · have he : ins (BinarySearchTree.Node w l r) v
          = BinarySearchTree.Node w (ins l v) r := by
        simp [ins, hc]
      rw [he]
      show view (ins l v) ∪ view r ∪ {w} = (view l ∪ view r ∪ {w}) ∪ {v}
      rw [ihl]
      ext x
      simp
      tauto
    · subst hc
      have he : ins (BinarySearchTree.Node v l r) v
          = BinarySearchTree.Node v l r := by
        simp [ins]
      rw [he]
      show view l ∪ view r ∪ {v} = (view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}) ∪ {v}
      ext x
      simp
    · have h1 : ¬ (v < w) := by omega
      have he : ins (BinarySearchTree.Node w l r) v
          = BinarySearchTree.Node w l (ins r v) := by
        simp [ins, h1, hc]
      rw [he]
      show view l ∪ view (ins r v) ∪ {w} = (view l ∪ view r ∪ {w}) ∪ {v}
      rw [ihr]
      ext x
      simp
      tauto

theorem bst_ins (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (h : is_bst t) :
    is_bst (ins t v) := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => simp [ins, is_bst, view]
  | Node w l r ihl ihr =>
    obtain ⟨hl, hbl, hr, hbr⟩ := h
    rcases lt_trichotomy v w with hc | hc | hc
    · have he : ins (BinarySearchTree.Node w l r) v
          = BinarySearchTree.Node w (ins l v) r := by
        simp [ins, hc]
      rw [he]
      refine ⟨?_, ihl hbl, hr, hbr⟩
      intro x hx
      rw [view_ins] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · exact hl x hx
      · simp at hx
        omega
    · subst hc
      have he : ins (BinarySearchTree.Node v l r) v
          = BinarySearchTree.Node v l r := by
        simp [ins]
      rw [he]
      exact ⟨hl, hbl, hr, hbr⟩
    · have h1 : ¬ (v < w) := by omega
      have he : ins (BinarySearchTree.Node w l r) v
          = BinarySearchTree.Node w l (ins r v) := by
        simp [ins, h1, hc]
      rw [he]
      refine ⟨hl, hbl, ?_, ihr hbr⟩
      intro x hx
      rw [view_ins] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · exact hr x hx
      · simp at hx
        omega
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem insert_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t v) :
    insert_postcond t v (insert t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  exact ⟨bst_ins t v h_precond, view_ins t v⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof

- **proof**: `exact ⟨bst_ins t v h_precond, view_ins t v⟩`.
